values.note: Single electric site $33, double $58, group site $70 (up to 40), historic cabin $150. Day use $5/vehicle. Two vehicles per single site; a daily fee for extra vehicles. (A second, older list on the FS page still shows $30/$50/$65.)

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/stuart-day-use-area-and-campground ('Single Site: $33 per night  Double Site: $58 per night  Group Site: $70 per night (up to 40 people)', last updated June 2, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232007/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 33, double 58), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:232007 (all 26 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 30) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232007 ('Each site comes with a campfire ring, tent pad, lantern post and electric hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 26 electric sites (25 single, 1 double) on one loop with long paved back-in spurs, 45 ft on the catalog (site 010 lists 99 ft); plus one non-electric group site and a historic cabin.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232007 ('The campground has 26 (25 single, 1 double) camping units with electric hookups ... paved spurs', 'a single loop with long spurs') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:232007 (Max Vehicle Length 45, Driveway Entry Back-In), read 2026-10-21

values.note: One six-unit flush restroom with four showers, plus vault toilets; dump station on site. Entrance gates locked 9 p.m. to 7 a.m.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232007 ('Drinking water and accessible flush toilets and showers are provided, with a dump station is on-site', 'two single-unit vault toilets, one double-unit vault toilet, and one six-unit flush restroom with four shower units'; notice 'Entrance gates are locked from 9 p.m. to 7 a.m.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All 26 campsites are reservable on recreation.gov, up to 11 months ahead and until 4 days before arrival; recreation.gov also notes 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites' (presumably unreserved sites taken on arrival). Weekends 2 nights, holiday weekends 3; 14-day limit; check-out 1 p.m. Concession-run (American Land & Leisure).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232007 (rules: reservationWindow 11 Months, reservationCutOff 4 days prior to arrival, minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:232007 (every campsite reservable: true, Site-Specific) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation/stuart-day-use-area-and-campground ('Maximum length of stay in campground is 14 days. Check-out time is 1:00 p.m.'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS campground on a bend of the Shavers Fork River about 6 miles NE of Elkins, built by the CCC; sites are not confirmed to be directly on the river. recreation.gov warns the recreation area may flood. --Claude
